name: eevee-volume-scatter-resource-guard
purpose: Verify that an Eevee world with volume absorption but no volume scattering or lights can render through the VOLUME_SCATTER shader variant without invalid light shader resource bindings.
passCriteria: The background render completes in factory-startup mode, the Render Result is 16x16, the output image is written, and the script prints EEVEE_VOLUME_SCATTER_RESOURCE_GUARD_OK.
